Linear Systems publishes the model as a PDF containing the .MODEL text, so no machine-readable vendor .lib exists to copy. notes: TRANSCRIPTION METHOD (ADR-013's accepted cost): two independent readings that had to agree, both taken from the FROZEN vendor copy. (1) Visual: qlmanage -t -s 2000 rasterised the PDF and the image was read. (2) Mechanical: scripts/pdf_glyphs.py, stdlib-only, inflates the content streams with zlib and recovers the characters from the Tj operators. The PDF uses a CID font whose glyph codes are NOT character codes; the mapping was NOT guessed - the PDF's own /ToUnicode CMap (52 entries) was parsed and used, and it happens to reduce to a single constant shift of +0x1D. The two readings came out BYTE-IDENTICAL (sha256 67012770a95340afcd346d8a32181f055350bd9d49f3e976b579001d5fc93888). A third reading with poppler pdftotext -layout agreed too, differing only by the trailing form-feed page separator. Full record: docs/preamp/reports/2026-09-09-L6-trascrizione-lsk489.md. WHY Mfg WAS REMOVED: ngspice evaluates the unknown parameter's value as an expression and dies - 'Undefined parameter [linear_systems]', 'ERROR: fatal error in ngspice, exit(1)'. Verified by running it. That failure is loud, not silent. FOUR PARAMETERS ARE ACCEPTED AND THEN IGNORED by ngspice, with a warning on every run: isr, alpha, vk, mj (PSpice/LTspice refinements of the gate junction and the saturation current). They are kept in the model line deliberately - minimal diff from the vendor text, and a simulator that supports them gets the vendor's own values. Those four warnings are EXPECTED output. The parameters NC-004 actually needs - Kf, Af, Nlev, Gdsnoi - are accepted by ngspice, which is the point of this file. SUFFIXES: docs/limitations.md #13 (KiCad '1M' = 1 megohm, SPICE '1M' = 1 milliohm) was checked against every suffix here and does NOT bite: 2.2m/4.3m/-2.5m are milli in both conventions, 3f/0.0009f femto, 3.19p/2.92p pico, 30u micro. Written down because this is exactly where a later reader would 'correct' a correct value. NOT YET CROSS-CHECKED AGAINST THE DATASHEET: step 4 of ADR-013 (transcribed I_DSS / V_P against the datasheet limits) is L7 and has not been done.
